files.name: Sportfish Galapagos Strategy and Redesign Brief

approximateLocation: San Cristobal, Galapagos, Ecuador; public US office in Everett, Massachusetts
listingFacts: Public business source describes offshore sportfishing with lodging, dining and island excursions. Peter and Al are named in the origin story. Contact page identifies Patagonia & Galapagos S.A. as the local operator, with a San Cristobal office and US office at 90 Main Street, Everett, MA 02149. Published public business contacts are recorded above. This is a charter business, not an Airbnb property.
hostStory: Public original site names Peter and Al and describes roughly two decades exploring the Galapagos. IGFA independently identifies Al DiFlumeri with Pete Santini. Formal captain biographies and individual credentials remain to be verified.
focus: Private sportfishing charters and qualified enquiries
homeContent: Existing redesign: home, fishing, boats, accommodations, expeditions, experience and story pages. Source code uses React/Babel in the browser; GitHub Pages serves docs/. Preserve the original site separately from the redesign.
additionalSources: Original: https://sportfishgalapagos.com/ ; Our Story: https://sportfishgalapagos.com/our-story/ ; Contact: https://sportfishgalapagos.com/contact/ ; landing page: https://galapagosfishingcharter.com/ ; repository: https://github.com/liza-bam/fishing ; strategy brief and full asset inventory linked in Files.
reviews: No independently verified guest review dataset located in the inspected repository. Do not manufacture reviews or turn marketing text into testimonials.
missing: Confirm Al's preferred business email/direct phone and any account identity. Redesign source has placeholder WhatsApp number +593000000000 and an enquiry form whose handler only prevents default and closes the drawer, with no transmission. Its hello@sportfishgalapagos.com email differs from the original site's info@sportfishgalapagos.com. Fleet count differs: home says five, story says six. Verify vessel list/specifications and claims before launch. Source image originality and licensing are not individually verified. No change to either website made.
